policy: Original GPT Image standalone generations; no reference-board crops. High-resolution originals retained locally. Shipped lossless PNGs normalized to authoring canvases; Explorer frames assembled from generated sheet and dedicated UP row.

revisions.reason: First effect contained architecture; rejected and replaced with isolated particle-only generation.
Initial V-shaped isometric corner conflicts with square grid camera.
Initial diagonal V corner conflicts with square grid camera.
Initial idle pose had a wide-open attack mouth.
Initial slither B remained coiled rather than moving.
Initial alert duplicated the attack pose.
Initial strike stayed in a stationary coil.
Rendered join strip showed inconsistent wall profile heights; regenerated from common straight module with fixed join geometry.
Rendered join strip showed inconsistent wall profile heights; regenerated from common straight module with fixed join geometry.
Rendered sheet repeated one stride in several columns; regenerated with opposite strides and two passing poses per row.
Full-sheet revision still repeated rear-view boot positions; generated a dedicated four-pose rear-view row and assembled into the normalized sheet.
Catalogue showed a full-height wall squeezed into low-wall display proportions.
Extended revision was too thin at 30px display size; compact S pose improves mobile readability.
